summary: Code review PASS. FiltersManagerView.axaml uses compiled Avalonia bindings (x:DataType) on both the root UserControl and the ListBox DataTemplate, giving compile-time binding validation. All bindings align with the actual FiltersManagerViewModel and FilterSlot model properties. Code-behind is correctly minimal. No blocking issues found.

comments.note: Compiled bindings are used correctly throughout: x:DataType="vm:FiltersManagerViewModel" on the UserControl root and x:DataType="models:FilterSlot" inside the ListBox DataTemplate. This gives compile-time binding validation, which is the correct Avalonia idiom.

Border element wrapping the DSL reference panel sets BorderThickness="1" and CornerRadius="4" but does not set BorderBrush. In Avalonia with the Fluent theme, the default BorderBrush on a Border is null/Transparent, meaning no visible border outline will render. If a subtle border was intended, BorderBrush should be set (e.g., via a theme resource brush). The panel is fully functional either way — this is a cosmetic observation only.

Add button is bound to SaveSlotCommand, which creates a new slot only when SelectedSlot is null (SlotId == 0) and updates otherwise. If a slot is currently selected, clicking Add will update it rather than create a new entry. The Developer has flagged this as a known UX limitation for a future ClearSelectionCommand. Not a bug per the current WP spec.
